headline: A 2002 executive order set up a federal task force to monitor and fight human trafficking.
what_it_does: This order created the President's Interagency Task Force to Monitor and Combat Trafficking in Persons. The task force brings together several federal agencies to coordinate the government's work against human trafficking. No summary was provided, so details about its members, duties, and powers are not described here.

who_it_affects.how: Agencies named to the task force would coordinate their efforts to track and respond to human trafficking.
The task force's work is aimed at combating trafficking, which may shape the federal response to people who are trafficked.
